title.en: Where Two Cultures Meet Over the Grill: Our 5-Course Yakitori Omakase & Palabok Tsukemen
title.zh: 当两种文化在炭火前相遇：五道式烧鸟 Omakase 与菲式鲜虾沾面

subtitle.en: Master Griller Vené introduces an intimate five-course binchotan progression alongside our newest cross-cultural creation.
subtitle.zh: 烧鸟主理人 Vené 呈献五道式备长炭火体验，并同步推出跨文化新作菲式鲜虾帕拉博克沾面。

content.en:
Every afternoon before our doors open at 5:00 PM on Xinhui Road, the rhythm in the kitchen is quiet and deliberate. Whole chickens are broken down by hand, shiitake caps are stuffed, and the binchotan charcoal is brought to a steady white-hot glow.

This season, we wanted to share two expressions of what Tori-Ji means to us: the discipline of traditional Japanese yakitori and the warmth of the Filipino flavors we grew up loving.

Our 5-Course Yakitori Omakase Night invites both solo diners and small groups to the counter for a curated progression of prized cuts—from crispy-skinned thigh and chicken oyster to our signature velvety liver and handmade tsukune—paired with house glazes and late-night conversation.

Alongside the counter experience, we are proud to introduce Palabok Tsukemen to the menu. Inspired by the celebratory noodle dish of the Philippines, springy Japanese dipping ramen meets a rich, slow-simmered shrimp and annatto sauce crowned with crisp chicharrón, toasted garlic, soft-boiled egg, and fresh calamansi lime.
content.zh:
每天下午 17:00 新会路门店开启前，后厨总是保持着安静而专注的节奏。手工分切整鸡、填制酿香菇，等待备长炭燃至透亮的白炽温度。

这一季，我们希望通过两种形式分享 Tori-Ji 的初心：对日式传统炭火烧鸟的敬畏，以及我们从小深爱的菲律宾家乡风味。

“五道式烧鸟 Omakase 晚宴”诚邀独自前来的食客与三五好友落座吧台，品尝由主理人 Vené 编排的稀有部位进程——从外焦里嫩的鸡腿肉、稀有鸡生蚝，到绵密如鹅肝的招牌鸡肝与月见鸡肉棒。

与此同时，我们的全新代表作“菲式鲜虾帕拉博克沾面（Palabok Tsukemen）”正式登场。劲道弹牙的日式粗沾面搭配浓郁虾汤红木籽酱汁，佐以酥脆炸猪皮、金黄蒜酥与清新四季橘，每一口都是日菲风味的默契共鸣。

title.en: Named Japanese Restaurant of the Year at the 23rd That's Shanghai Awards
title.zh: Tori-Ji 荣膺第23届《That's Shanghai》年度最佳日本料理餐厅大奖

subtitle.en: A heartfelt thank you to our Shanghai community for turning two ordinary OFWs' dream into an award-winning home.
subtitle.zh: 衷心感谢上海食客社群的陪伴，让两个普通创业者的梦想成为获奖的温暖之家。

content.en:
Less than a year after lighting our first charcoal fire at 549 Xinhui Road, Tori-Ji was honored with Japanese Restaurant of the Year (People's Choice) at the 23rd That's Shanghai Food & Drink Awards.

When we left our corporate paths to build Tori-Ji from scratch, our promise was simple: 'We make it here. By hand. By fire. So we don't live with what ifs.'

This recognition belongs to every guest who sat at our counter, shared a sizzling Yakitori Sisig Skillet, left a Polaroid note on our wall, and called Tori-Ji their second home in Shanghai.
content.zh:
在新会路 549 号点燃第一炉炭火不到一年，Tori-Ji 便在第23届《That's Shanghai》餐饮大奖中斩获“年度最佳日本料理餐厅（大众选择奖）”殊荣。

当我们毅然告别原本的职场轨迹、从零创立 Tori-Ji 时，心中的承诺简单而坚定：“手作穿串，直面炭火，只为人生不留遗憾。”

这份荣誉属于每一位曾落座吧台、分享铁板烧鸟西西格、在拍立得墙上留下手写便签，并将 Tori-Ji 称为“上海第二个家”的客人。

title.en: Filipino Feast: An Intimate 15-Seat Supper Club Over Banana Leaves
title.zh: Filipino Feast 菲式家宴：仅限 15 席的芭蕉叶长桌私享会

subtitle.en: Heirloom dishes shared by hand, stories from the kitchen, and unhurried evenings together.
subtitle.zh: 在芭蕉叶长桌上分享记忆中的家乡菜，聆听主厨故事，共度自在微醺的夜晚。

content.en:
At the heart of Filipino hospitality is the communal table—where dishes are placed in the center, stories are passed around, and strangers leave as friends.

Our Filipino Feast Supper Club limits each gathering to just 15 guests. Across a long table lined with fragrant banana leaves, we serve a multi-course spread of garlic shrimp, charcoal-grilled liempo, boneless chicken inasal, crunchy chicharrón, and sizzling sisig.

Reserve your seat ahead via WeChat to join our next monthly table.
content.zh:
菲律宾待客之道的核心在于“共享餐桌”——丰盛的料理摆在长桌中央，故事在欢笑间流转，初识的陌生人在晚餐结束时已成好友。

我们的 Filipino Feast 菲式长桌家宴每场仅设 15 席。在铺满清香芭蕉叶的餐桌上，依次呈上蒜香大虾、炭烤厚切五花肉、无骨菲式烤鸡腿排、酥脆炸猪皮与铁板 Sisig。

欢迎通过官方微信提前预订下一期家宴席位。
